description: This file contains CSS styles for the layout of a web application's user interface, including classes for shell layout, topbar, navigation sidebar, content area, and responsive adjustments.

classes.name: .shell
classes.description: Main layout container defining grid areas for navigation, topbar, and content, with adaptable styling for different states such as chat mode, onboarding, and collapsed sidebar.

classes.name: .topbar
classes.description: Styling for the top navigation bar, including positioning, background, and embedded elements like breadcrumb, status indicators, and theme mode toggle.

classes.name: .shell-nav
classes.description: Sidebar navigation styling, including collapsible widths, header, footer, and menu items with hover and active states.

classes.name: .content
classes.description: Main content area styling with padding, scrolling, and responsive layout adjustments.

classes.name: .content-header
classes.description: Header section within content area, including title, metadata, and controls with transition effects for focus and chat modes.

classes.name: .grid
classes.description: Utility class for CSS grid layouts with different column configurations.
